items.source: The response body stream can then be consumed further with the "reactor-test" StepVerifier and cancelled when enough elements have been consumed from the (possibly infinite) stream:
items.translation: 响应体流随后可以使用 "reactor-test" 的 `<code>StepVerifier` 进行进一步消费，并在从（可能是无限的）流中消费了足够多的元素后取消：

items.source:
Invoke the given consumer within ExchangeResult.assertWithDiagnostics(Runnable) passing "this" instance to it. This method allows the following, without leaving the WebTestClient chain of calls: 
client.get()
                .uri("/persons")
                .accept(TEXT_EVENT_STREAM)
                .exchange()
                .expectStatus().isOk()
        .returnResult()
        .consumeWith(result -> assertThat(...);
items.translation:
在 `ExchangeResult.assertWithDiagnostics(Runnable)` 中调用给定的消费者，并将 "this" 实例传递给它。此方法允许在不离开 WebTestClient 调用链的情况下执行以下操作： 
client.get()
                .uri("/persons")
                .accept(TEXT_EVENT_STREAM)
                .exchange()
                .expectStatus().isOk()
        .returnResult()
        .consumeWith(result -> assertThat(...);

items.source: Invoke the given consumer within ExchangeResult.assertWithDiagnostics(Runnable) passing "this" instance to it.
items.translation: 在 `ExchangeResult.assertWithDiagnostics(Runnable)` 中调用给定的 consumer，并将 `"this"` 实例传递给它。

items.translation: ExchangeResult 变体，其响应体已解码为 Flux<T> 但尚未被消费。
